title: M3-3 final directive remediation 7: comprehensive plan-completion audit
objective: Extend the plan audit into the final development gate: a reconciled requirement inventory (specification, AUD-01..07, AUD-01a-d, B0-B8, PB-AUD-01..08, owner decisions DEC-01..10, eligibility), the directive's completion statuses with an evidence rule, semantic checks, reruns from pinned inputs (exploratory v2/v3, the corrected Phase B evaluation, thresholds, a deterministic simulation sample and summary, prospective archive verification, live content verification), negative controls proving the audit detects failure, and a fresh receipt with the overall assessment.
next_action: Read affected requirements/source and record Review evidence

journal.note: The audit caught a regression from Phase E: a docstring note added to arbit_model/feature_specs.py changed a v0 file that must stay byte-identical (v0:bytes, rerun:continuity, open:owner-weight failed). Restored to its v0 bytes; the note remains in AGENTS.md, RESEARCH_ELIGIBILITY.md and the eligibility module. Scope extended by hand with feature_specs.py.

A negative control found backtest:variants too coarse (it checked variant families pooled across groups, so a variant missing for one group passed). Strengthened to require every configured variant for every group in every stage.
